officialSdkNote: SUPERSEDES the earlier record here, which said 'not-installed' and false. That reading was true of the V1 line ONLY: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.32.1 declares LATEST_PROTOCOL_VERSION=2025-11-25 and cannot speak revision 2026-07-28. The V2 line DOES implement it - the server and client packages export DiscoverRequestSchema, DiscoverResultSchema and PROTOCOL_VERSION_META_KEY, and the server package's own source serves the 2026-07-28 protocol revision. What remains true is subtler and is NOT a gap in this repository: v2's LATEST_PROTOCOL_VERSION is STILL 2025-11-25 because that constant describes the LEGACY handshake, so the modern era is OPT-IN. A default-configured client negotiates initialize at 2025-11-25 and never probes, which is why this server - where discovery REPLACED the handshake - answers -32601 to it. Setting versionNegotiation mode 'auto' makes the official client probe with server/discover, and it then CONNECTS to this server, lists its tools and runs real inference through tools/call.
